# India Tax

Guide for **India Tax** APIs in Giddh.

## Authentication

Send `Auth-Key` or `Session-Id`. Base URL: `https://api.giddh.com`.

## Open in API Reference

Full request/response schemas: [India Tax](/p/india-tax?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)

- [Get All Tax Numbers](/p/get-all-tax-numbers?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Create India Tax](/p/create-india-tax?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Get India Tax](/p/get-india-tax?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)

## Notes

- Prefer endpoint pages for exact query params, body fields, and examples.
- For voucher / business-document flows, pass `voucherVersion=2` when the endpoint documents it.
